en.text_help_tooltip:
Certain words in the text fields will be replaced by values, in case you don't want to figure out the clan/cat age while still including it. These keywords are:
'clanage'- age of your clan in moons
'catage'- age of the living cat in moons
'clan_[leader/deputy/prophet]'- your clan's leader, deputy or prophet; do not include the square brackets or slashes
